name: steam-reviews-overlay
description: Browser extension that overlays Steam review summaries on game cards

scripts.build: npm run build:chrome && npm run build:firefox && npm run build:safari
scripts.safari:xcode: xcrun safari-web-extension-converter dist/safari --project-location build/safari --app-name "Steam Reviews Overlay" --bundle-identifier com.arcataroger.Steam-Reviews-Overlay --macos-only --no-open --force
scripts.lint: npm run build:firefox && web-ext lint --source-dir dist/firefox
scripts.inventory:crawl: node scripts/inventory.mjs docs/inventory/pages $(node -e "for (const e of require('./docs/inventory/nav-urls.json')) console.log(e.url)")
scripts.inventory: npm run inventory:nav && npm run inventory:crawl && npm run inventory:merge

author: arcataroger
